# Startup Team Composition Analysis Skill for Muse

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @wshobson. A planning advisor for early-stage founders: it designs team structures, role-by-role hiring plans, compensation ranges, and equity allocation matched to funding milestones from pre-seed through Series A, tying headcount to revenue and budget constraints. Honest notes: guidance only — it produces plans and benchmarks, not legal, tax, or accounting advice on equity and compensation; benchmarks reflect the skill's reference data, not live market rates, so cross-check numbers that matter; it can't interview your candidates or verify your cap table.
